meta.badge: Precomputed · one car at a time
meta.scene_banner: Scenes are placeholders. The test-set numbers are real (one car at a time). The road scenes and per-vehicle attacker probabilities are still synthetic until the exported file is loaded.
meta.utility_note: Errors are Cartesian meters on the full 1,505,756-sample test set, each car encoded with only its own neighbours.
sources: All numbers: one car at a time (each car encoded with only its own neighbours), verified against true single-car runs to within 0.09 ft.
Attack: the original MLP attacker recipe and seed, retrained on one-car representations of each encoder and tested on the 236,914-sample attack test split. Majority guess (always I-80) is 53.4%.
Trajectory error: Cartesian RMSE, ADE and FDE in meters on the full 1,505,756-sample NGSIM test set. TAPPFL uses the round-8 retrained decoder.
Raw-history probe: the same MLP on the ego car's raw 3 s (x, y) history, no model: 74.9%.

scatter_note: Only two settings have both measurements. No other λ value has been evaluated for both utility and leakage.
grid_note: Majority guess means always answering I-80.
training_summary: Recorded curves arrive with the export
training_empty: Per-round curves (utility loss, privacy loss, adversary accuracy) will be pulled from the run logs.
